sources.label: Fictional Keynote Transcript
sources.text: Every system we ship must explain itself in the same breath it acts. We are not asking users to trust the machine; we are asking the machine to show its work every single time, without exception, because a claim nobody can check is not a fact, it is a hope. The team spent the spring building three small tools before one large one, because small tools fail small and large tools fail large. None of this replaces judgment. It only makes judgment auditable.

claims.quote: we are asking the machine to show its work every single time, without exception
we are asking the machine to show its work every single day, without exception
The company guarantees zero downtime for every customer forever.
